name: Metalcraft Assistant
tagline: Your calendar, notes, email, drive and contacts — one agent.
description: The ecosystem agent: an orchestrator that delegates to the specialist persona for each Metalcraft service, authenticated by a single account token.

personas.description: Delegates each job to the specialist built for it

Manages a Metalcraft user's calendars — lists their calendars, searches events by time window, and (with a write token) creates, updates, and deletes events, keeping any linked Google calendar in sync.

Saves and organizes markdown notes in Metalcraft Notes — lists notes and categories, reads notes and their links, and (with a write token) creates, updates, and deletes flat notes written as plain markdown, cross-linked with [[slug]] wikilinks and tagged with color-coded categories.

Reads a Metalcraft user's email — lists connected mailboxes, searches and lists messages, reads full messages and threads. Read-only: it can find and summarize mail but never sends, replies, deletes, or modifies it.
Manages a Metalcraft user's files — browses folders, finds files, creates folders, and (with a write token) uploads, renames, moves, stars, trashes, and deletes files on Metalcraft Drive.

Manages the user's personal contacts in Metalcraft Contacts — lists and searches people, reads a contact's full details, and (with a write token) creates, updates, and deletes contacts, plus surfaces upcoming birthdays.

A remote coding agent: provisions an ephemeral sprites.dev workspace, clones a GitHub repo into it, reads and edits code, runs commands, builds and smoke-tests, configures GitHub Actions, and commits & pushes — all against code.metalcraftai.com.

Helps a user discover integrations in the Metalcraft Packs registry — searches and browses the catalog, explains what a pack does and which keys it needs, and points the user to install it on their agent.
Reads the user's Metalcraft Calendar for today and composes a concise plain-text agenda. Built for the scheduled morning-brief flow, whose own send step delivers it as a push.
